descriptors.description: Metadata describing an entity or shared processing inputs, with named References to representations

references.name: references
references.description: Reference type buckets containing named References; names are unique across all buckets and the map can be empty

url.name: url
url.description: Absolute fragment-free retrieval URL, used without modification

data.name: data
data.description: Profile-defined inline values keyed by type; values follow Core and applicable profile definitions and are not retrieved as References

entityid.name: entityid
entityid.description: Absolute fragment-free identity URI of the primary entity; not a retrieval instruction

entitytype.name: entitytype
entitytype.description: Type URI with a scheme from an agreed vocabulary; a fragment can identify an ontology class; requires entityid
